_comment: TST-05 offline SAST ruleset (Phase 6 lane L4). Repository-owned, deterministic, zero external service, zero network. Fail-closed: any match => analyzer exit 1. These rules target dangerous-code antipatterns ONLY — secret/env scanning is explicitly OUT OF SCOPE (gitleaks/.gitleaks.toml owns that boundary; see scripts/scan-secrets.sh). Files in scripts/__fixtures__/ are excluded from the default scan and are scanned explicitly by scripts/sast.test.mjs.

rules.name: Dynamic eval() / new Function() (JS/TS)
rules.message: Dynamic code evaluation with attacker-influenceable input enables arbitrary code execution. Reject the input or use a whitelist. NOTE: this rule does not scan secrets/env.
rules.rationale: CWE-95. `eval`/`new Function` with non-constant input is RCE.

rules.name: child_process exec/execSync with a command string (JS/TS)
rules.message: exec/execSync runs a shell; interpolated input is command injection. Use spawn with an argument array and shell:false.
rules.rationale: CWE-78. Shell interpolation of untrusted input => command injection.

rules.name: spawn/spawnSync with shell enabled (JS/TS)
rules.message: spawn with shell:true reintroduces shell interpretation; pass an argument array with shell:false.
rules.rationale: CWE-78. shell:true defeats spawn's argv-array protection.

rules.name: DOM HTML sink with dynamic content (React/JSX)
rules.message: Assigning non-static content to an HTML sink enables stored/reflected XSS. Render via React text nodes or escape first.
rules.rationale: CWE-79. innerHTML/insertAdjacentHTML with untrusted data => XSS.

rules.name: subprocess with shell=True (Python)
rules.message: shell=True reintroduces shell interpretation of the command string; pass an argument list with shell=False.
rules.rationale: CWE-78. Python subprocess shell=True => command injection.

rules.name: os.system/os.popen (Python)
rules.message: os.system/os.popen run a shell; use subprocess with an argument list.
rules.rationale: CWE-78. os.system passes the string to /bin/sh.

rules.name: Dynamic eval()/exec() (Python)
rules.message: Dynamic code execution with non-constant input is RCE; use an AST whitelist or data-driven design.
rules.rationale: CWE-95. eval/exec with untrusted input => arbitrary code execution.

rules.name: Unsafe pickle deserialization (Python)
rules.message: pickle.load/loads executes arbitrary objects during deserialization; use JSON or a safe format for untrusted data.
rules.rationale: CWE-502. Unpickling untrusted data => arbitrary code execution.

rules.name: Shell eval with variable input (sh/bash)
rules.message: eval of interpolated shell input is command injection; use direct execution with quoted arguments.
rules.rationale: CWE-78. eval re-parses its argument as shell syntax.

rules.name: Unpinned curl|bash / wget|sh installer (shell/yaml)
rules.message: Remote pipe-to-shell installers cannot be pinned/reproduced and execute third-party code; vendor the installer or pin a verified release.
rules.rationale: Supply-chain / SLSA. Unpinned remote code execution at build time.
